text: Schedule No. (1) Bill of Quantities for 6 October Northern Extensions - 220/22/22 kV GIS Substation. Supply and installation of 220 kV GIS, Power Transformer 60 MVA, 22 kV Switchgear. Tender security EGP 500,000 valid for 180 days. Experience: similar 220kV GIS projects in last 5 years. Schedule: 12 months delivery. Consortium: joint venture allowed.

1- 220/22/22 kV, 175 MVA Transformers
2- 220 kV GIS
3- 220 kV GIS Circuit Breaker
4- 220 kV GIS Inductive Voltage Transformer
5- 214 kV Surge Arrestor
6- 220 kV CCVT
7- SAS
8- Fiber optic
9- DPLC
10- Protective relays
Commercial terms: Fixed price, payment in EGP, delivery 12 months, penalty for delay 0.5% per week, termination clause.

Tender Document Volume 1 - 6 October Northern Extensions. Tender No. Mobile-2024-001. Client: NUCA - New Urban Communities Authority. Location: 6th October City. Voltage: 22-22-22 kV GIS. Experience: successful continuous operation 3 years. Financial capacity: audited financials turnover 100M EGP. Deadline: submission 15 of March, 2024.
